target.name: Research and development
target.quote: 2025 R&D expenses decreased by $2.8 billion, or 17%, from 2024

other_items.name: Marketing, general, and administrative
other_items.quote: Total R&D and MG&A expenses for 2025 were $18.4 billion, down 17% compared to 2024

input.note: The filing shows R&D decreased by $2.8 billion from 2024 to 2025. Operating loss improved from $(11,888) million in 2024 to $(2,214) million in 2025 (narrowed by $9,674 million). To calculate R&D figures: 2025 total R&D and MG&A was $18.4 billion, and from E13 charts/context, R&D was approximately $13.9 billion in 2025 vs $16.6 billion in 2024. MG&A decreased from $5.5 billion to $4.5 billion. The filing also shows significant changes in cost of sales and restructuring charges that contributed to the narrowing of operating loss.
